title: Self-Pay Charge for a Visit Past the Payer's Visit Limit — Insured Plan of Care
content:
**Patient financial terms — Insured Plan of Care.**

**The visit charged.** The visit charged is the latest billed visit on the plan of care by date of service, the date of service that runs past the visit limit, and it is held in the appointment series the plan of care funds.

**The charge.** The non-covered visit charge is the payer program's self-pay visit rate, rounded half up to the cent. The charge is never below zero, and it is rounded half up to the cent only once, as the final figure.

## Worked illustration (hypothetical)

A plan's billed visits fall on 2026-08-04, 2026-08-06 and 2026-08-11. The visit charged is the one dated 2026-08-11, the latest by date of service. On a payer program whose self-pay visit rate is $118.00, the charge for that visit is $118.00.

## Points of judgement

- **Which visit?** The latest billed visit on the plan, ordered by date of service.
- **Whose rate?** The rate of the payer program the plan of care is billed under, as shown in that program's non-covered visit terms.
- **Rounding.** One rounding, half up to the cent, on the final charge only.
